---
name: create-instructions
description: generate an agent instructions .md file
agent: instructions-generator
---

<!-- Tip: Use /create-prompt in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

Take the information below and generate an agent instructions .md file for it in the ./docs/ directory.If the .md file is provided, use that, otherwise generate an appropriate file name based on the generated content. Make sure the instructions concise and not too long. Make sure update AGENTS.md file to reference this new docs file. If no information is provided below, prompt user to give the necessory details about the layer of architecture or coding standards that the instructions should cover. The generated .md file should follow the format and conventions specified in AGENTS.md and the relevant .md file in /docs/. The content should be focused on providing clear guidelines for agents working on that specific aspect of the project, and should be aligned with the overall project guidelines and conventions. The instructions should be easy to understand and follow for other agents, and should be actionable and directly applicable to the tasks that agents will be working on. Consider the specific tools and capabilities that agents have access to when generating the instructions, and aim to create content that is relevant and useful for their work.
